narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the repository structure.
finalText:
**Migrated 36 `db.query` calls across 12 files.**

All now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`. Output matches the already-migrated files like [user.js:9](packages/accounts/src/repo/user.js:9). Every file passes `node --check`.

Two calls stay in [adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. It is replaced on each upgrade.

`cache.query` is untouched. Different thing, same name.

Next: ask `legacy-orm` upstream to move off `db.query`.
